name: com.loreman.unity
description: Plays the dialogues of a Loreman project in Unity. A .lorebuild file made by Loreman is turned into Addressables and Unity Localization tables, so a dialogue and its texts are loaded only when the game needs them.

samples.description: Start a dialogue, show lines and choices, play the voice-over, switch the language while it runs.
Preload a dialogue ahead of time, save the place in it and resume later, read the designer's note of a line.
